snippets.text: An extreme close view: a single feature crosses the whole frame.

snippets.name: Wide lens 24mm

snippets.name: Standard 50mm
snippets.text: Taken on a standard lens at a natural distance, near and far holding their true proportion to one another.

snippets.name: Shallow focus
snippets.text: Sharpness holds on the subject alone and falls away quickly in front of them and behind.

snippets.name: Deep focus
snippets.text: Sharpness carries from the nearest part of the frame through to the furthest.

snippets.name: Focus behind the subject
snippets.text: Sharpness sits behind the subject, who softens a little in front of it.

snippets.name: Fine grain
snippets.text: Fine even grain across the whole frame, sitting close under the detail rather than over it.

snippets.name: Coarse grain
snippets.text: Coarse grain standing clear of the detail, heaviest through the middle tones.

snippets.name: Gentle roll-off
snippets.text: The brightest tones give way gradually and the darkest hold their separation, the steps keeping their spacing at both ends.

snippets.name: Hard contrast
snippets.text: A long way between the brightest and darkest tones, the steps crowding together at both ends.

snippets.name: Low contrast
snippets.text: A short way between the brightest and darkest tones, the whole picture sitting in the middle of its range.

snippets.name: Warm cast
snippets.text: The whole picture leans warm, the light tones carrying amber and the shadows a soft brown.

snippets.name: Cool cast
snippets.text: The whole picture leans cool, the light tones carrying blue and the shadows a deep slate.

snippets.name: Muted colour
snippets.text: The colours run quiet and close together, the strongest of them still held well short of full.

snippets.name: Saturated colour
snippets.text: The colours run hard and hold their strength into the shadows.

snippets.name: Soft edges
snippets.text: Tones cross into one another over a wide gentle boundary.

snippets.name: Crisp edges
snippets.text: Tones cross into one another over a narrow hard boundary.

snippets.name: Halation
snippets.text: Bright areas bleed a soft warm glow into the tone beside them.

snippets.name: Medium format
snippets.text: The character of a medium format negative: a long tonal range, fine grain, and a smooth fall from sharp to soft.

snippets.name: 35mm film
snippets.text: The character of 35mm film: visible grain, a gentle roll-off at both ends, and colour that sits a little off true.

snippets.name: Available light
snippets.text: Recorded on available light alone, the exposure held where the scene put it.

snippets.name: Before dawn
snippets.text: The hour before sunrise: the light flat and blue, the air still cold, the space holding its own colour rather than the sky's.

snippets.name: Early morning
snippets.text: Early morning, the sun low and coming in long across the space, the air clear and cool.

snippets.name: Midday sun
snippets.text: Midday, the sun high and hard overhead, the shadows short and sharp beneath everything.

snippets.name: Late afternoon
snippets.text: Late afternoon, the light low and warm and raking across the surfaces from one side.

snippets.name: Golden hour
snippets.text: The last half hour of sun: the light warm and level, coming in almost flat across the space.

snippets.name: Blue hour
snippets.text: The half hour after sunset: the sky still holding light, the space lit evenly and cool with the sun already gone.

snippets.name: Night
snippets.text: Night, the space lit by whatever stands in it, the light pooling where its sources are and falling away between them.

snippets.name: Overcast
snippets.text: A flat overcast day, the light coming from the whole sky at once and settling evenly over everything.

snippets.name: After rain
snippets.text: Just after rain: every surface wet and returning the light, the air washed and clear.

snippets.name: Fog
snippets.text: Fog through the space, the far parts of it going pale and thin while the near parts hold their colour.

snippets.name: Window light
snippets.text: Daylight through a single opening, strong where it lands and falling away quickly into the rest of the room.

snippets.name: Practical light
snippets.text: The space lit by the lamps standing in it, warm and close around each one.

snippets.name: Backlit
snippets.text: The light comes from behind the space, running towards the camera and lifting the edges of everything it passes.

snippets.name: Correct hands

snippets.name: Hair in the air
snippets.text: Fine strands lift free of the mass and follow the air rather than any arrangement.

snippets.name: Skin at pore level
snippets.text: Real living skin rendered at pore level: fine visible texture, open pores, delicate tonal variation, faint natural imperfection.

snippets.name: Makeup that reads as skin
snippets.text: The makeup is finished by a master hand and reads as skin, a soft base with the natural texture left intact.

snippets.name: A coat over the arm
